_readme: Spec 38 §11.2 (D427 amendment) — the CURATED MorphSVG shape-PAIR presets. ONE file, read by BOTH sides on purpose: includes/fx-shape-routes.php reads it for the render-layer expansion (it needs both `d` strings), and src/blocks/extensions/fx.js imports it for the thumbnail picker (it needs the same `d` strings to draw each thumbnail, plus the labels). A second copy would be a sixth hand-kept motion list that nothing cross-checks — the same drift class fx-path-routes.json exists to close for motion-path. It lives in includes/ rather than src/ because includes/ ships to the server; webpack imports .json natively, so the editor side needs no generator step.
_geometry: Every shape is authored in a 0 0 100 100 viewBox, matched as closely as a hand-authored preset reasonably can be for MorphSVGPlugin's point-matching (it re-samples on a mismatch rather than refusing to run — see fx-morph.js's own docblock — so an imperfect match still animates, just with more redistribution). `from` is what the FROM state (the resting shape, shown when the effect never runs at all — no JS, reduced motion, a failed asset gate) looks like; `to` is what it morphs into.

circle-square.label: Circle to square
circle-square.description: A circle reshapes into a square.

plus-cross.label: Plus to cross
plus-cross.description: An upright plus sign reshapes into a diagonal cross (X).

play-pause.label: Play to pause
play-pause.description: A play triangle reshapes into a pause icon (two bars).

logo-icon.label: Logo mark to icon
logo-icon.description: An abstract 4-point spark reshapes into a rounded badge — the generic "brand mark becomes an icon" flourish.
